nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Tight 'n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner

segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin are sharply divided: several describe stinging that escalates to burning across the whole face, with one stopping use entirely, while others with self-described super-sensitive skin find it works great or even too gentle to feel like a real AHA, with no residue or irritation at all.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who calls her skin oily and textured with visible pores, report a noticeable improvement and describe the toner as cooling and calming.
segments.dry: The one reviewer with dry skin reports it leaves her skin slightly tight right after rinsing it off, but still loves the overall results enough to keep using it.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with an oily T-zone and enlarged pores, report their skin feels more balanced, though one didn't notice her pores actually getting smaller and found the foam left her hands feeling sticky.
segments.mature: The reviewer who names her skin as mature reports it tightens her skin and layers well under her serum and moisturizer.

concerns.aging: Beyond pore size, many reviewers across skin types report an immediate tightening or firming sensation on application, including the one reviewer who specifically calls her skin mature; no reviewer reports the opposite effect.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as lightweight and non-drying, with several specifically noting no dryness or irritation afterward; the one reviewer with dry skin is the exception, saying it leaves her skin a little tight right after rinsing, though she still values the results.
concerns.redness: Reports here split by reviewer: several, including some with sensitive skin, describe stinging that develops into burning, sometimes across the whole face; other reviewers, including one with super-sensitive skin, report the opposite, no irritation at all, and one specifically credits it with calming her usual redness overnight.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, and a few specifically credit it with clearing existing acne within days; a handful disagree, describing breakouts after use, including a couple of small pimples along the jawline that one reviewer wonders may have been pores clearing out.
concerns.oiliness: The two reviewers who mention oil control both report their combination or oily skin feels more balanced after use, though one didn't notice any change in pore size specifically.

aspects.libelle: Novel foam format, no cotton rounds
Stings or burns on application for some
Leaves tiny glitter-like specks on skin
Can feel sticky, especially on hands
Fancy metal can, foam dispenses cold
A little goes a long way
Pleasant, not overpowering scent for most

extraits.titre: not bad but beware if you have acne or sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: take this with a grain of salt because i have sensitive skin with a few blemishes here and there. ive been using this for about 6 weeks. when i first started using this product, it would sting REALLY bad on any little blemish i had, even the smallest ones. i continued to use it because i started to see a bit of a difference in my pores, but now it literally burns my whole face, i had to stop using it. maybe this would be good if you dont have any acne or you dont have sensitive skin, but i must warn anyone else who does!

Some of the comments have me shaking my head. This is a 'Pore' toner….. we do not have pores in our eyes, therefore, it should not go there, and it won't sting. I have super sensitive skin, and if anything, I found this to be too gentle for a AHA feel. It absolutely DOES NOT leave a residue on your face and or do you feel like you put anything on? That's how great it goes into the skin. But toners and specifically this delivery as it is foam, is best applied to damp skin as soon as you are done washing your face. If you've been sitting around for a long time, and your skin is completely dry, then you might feel something. Toners and serums are best. Applied to semi damp skin. Facial water sprays are a great tool if you've not dampened your skin. I find this product left my skin very glow after about six days of use. You can get rid of pours indefinitely. So no product is going to do that, but this product has definitely made my skin look glowy
I cant say enough about this. I have horrible oily and textured skin, pores, the works. I am noticing a great difference in my skin.

Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics in exchange for my review. A great product for combination skin. I have enlarged pores, oily skin through my t zone and this really helped make my skin feel even the slightest bit balanced. I didn't necessarily notice my pores to be any smaller. The foam application is nice but makes my hands feel a little sticky.

extraits.titre: Easy, effortless step in my skincare routine
extraits.texte: I love this product. I use it on my face in the morning after cleansing and it really feels like it tightens my mature skin. I love that I can apply it with my fingers and it absorbs into the skin without feeling sticky. 1-2 pumps is all you need and it layers beautifully under serum and moisturizer.

extraits.titre: Fun Foamy step to your skincare!
extraits.texte: This toner definitely adds a fun foamy step to my skincare routine and it works well with the rest of my products. It absorbs quickly into the skin and it's very lightweight. I've been using it for the past two weeks and can definitely see a difference in my skin. As a dry skin girlie it does leave my skin a little tight after washing it off but still love the results!
I havent used enough to see if it works but every time I use it my face breaks out
